name: Order Detail
summary: Passive title-labelled single-order composition with optional target metadata, canonical Steps progress, and read-only canonical Cart Line Item records.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Required passive section named from the visible order title and established as the U5 inline-size container.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Required title and optional metadata grouping whose private layout responds to U5 width.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible heading that labels the section; the target selects the context-appropriate heading rank.

anatomy.name: meta
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned semantic order metadata such as a native date or readable status composition.

anatomy.name: tracking
anatomy.description: Optional provider-trusted finite ordered milestones projected through canonical Steps; omitted when target facts do not form a trustworthy linear sequence.

anatomy.name: items
anatomy.description: Optional accessibly named purchased-items region containing a native canonical Cart Line Item list.

anatomy.name: lineItem
anatomy.description: Repeated read-only canonical Cart Line Item record supplied by the target without cart mutation controls.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Single neutral order-detail profile; metadata and dependency regions are composition, not visual variants.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic named-container profile with a private stacked-header threshold.

states.name: metadataPresent
states.description: Optional target-owned semantic metadata is present.

states.name: trackingPresent
states.description: Optional canonical Steps composition is present; completed/current/upcoming are dependency and target projections, not U5 states.

states.name: lineItemsPresent
states.description: Optional non-empty read-only canonical Cart Line Item collection is present.

behavior.name: requiredTitle
behavior.description: A trimmed non-empty visible title is required; missing title omits the complete renderer rather than creating an unnamed section.

behavior.name: headingContext
behavior.description: Targets choose the heading element that fits the host page outline; U5 does not hardcode one global heading rank.

behavior.name: orderData
behavior.description: Title and optional metadata come from one authoritative order and are localized/formatted by the target.

behavior.name: metadataSemantics
behavior.description: When metadata represents a date or time, targets preserve a native time element with a conforming machine-readable value.

behavior.name: trackingComposition
behavior.description: Optional tracking composes canonical passive Steps only from a provider-trusted finite ordered milestone model; the target supplies order, labels, completion and at most one current step.

behavior.name: trackingTruth
behavior.description: U5 never infers a universal sequence from processing, fulfillment, shipment, pickup, return, refund, partial, split, or cancellation facts. When those facts are not a trustworthy linear model, omit Steps and render ordinary target-authored semantic status content.

behavior.name: lineItemsComposition
behavior.description: Optional purchased products use a non-empty native canonical Cart Line Item collection.

behavior.name: readOnlyPurchase
behavior.description: Purchased quantity is readable content; Quantity Selector, removal, save-for-later, add-to-cart, and other cart commands are prohibited from the U5 profile.

behavior.name: productNavigation
behavior.description: An available Cart Line Item title destination keeps canonical native Link semantics; target routing owns navigation, history, focus, and feedback.

behavior.name: optionalRegions
behavior.description: Metadata, tracking, and line items are independently optional and their empty wrappers are omitted.

behavior.name: externalLifecycle
behavior.description: Authentication, authorization, redaction, queries, loading, error, unavailable, not-found, expired-session, live updates, formatting, routing, analytics, and telemetry remain outside passive U5.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: The root is a named inline-size container; private header composition changes by component width while DOM order remains title, metadata, tracking, items.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Neutral U5 owns no listener, observer, timer, request, state mapper, formatter, auth SDK, tracker, or internal live region.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required non-empty localized visible order title and accessible section-name source; target context owns heading rank.

properties.name: meta
properties.description: Optional target-owned semantic order date, status, or supporting metadata.

properties.name: tracking
properties.description: Optional provider-trusted finite ordered milestone records projected through canonical Steps; omit when target facts are non-linear or uncertain. U5 defines no stage inventory or current-index state.

properties.name: lineItems
properties.description: Optional non-empty read-only canonical Cart Line Item collection without cart mutation controls.

accessibility: Render a section labelled by its required non-empty visible title and omit the complete component when that title is absent.
Use a heading rank appropriate to the surrounding page and preserve native time semantics when metadata represents a date or time.
Compose tracking from canonical native ordered Steps with readable status, at most one aria-current step, and no custom widget keyboard model.
Use Steps only for provider-trusted ordered milestones. When authoritative facts are non-linear or uncertain, omit Steps and expose ordinary semantic status content instead of fabricating progress.
Do not communicate progress only through connector, indicator, or color; canonical completed and current semantics must remain available as text or native state.
Keep purchased items in a native canonical Cart Line Item list and omit cart mutation controls from the read-only order profile.
Preserve native Link focus and activation when a valid product destination exists; do not make the complete row or order section a second interactive surface.
Keep title, metadata, tracking, and items in stable DOM order across container sizes, localization, RTL, zoom, forced colors, and reduced motion.
Protect or redact order details according to the target authentication and authorization context before providing U5 content.

web.notes: Implemented as a zero-runtime named-container section composed from canonical Steps and Cart Line Item.

shopify.notes: Shopify v1 uses the hosted current-account Order status page as an intentional native handoff with no U5 parity claim. Target-controlled extensions or headless storefronts may project authoritative U5 metadata, provider-trusted Steps and read-only purchase lines. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not target readiness.

react.notes: Thin wrapper over canonical Steps and Cart Line Item adapters with external authoritative order state.
